sentences.text:
This Misc. Appeal under Section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed by the appellant assailing the impugned award dated 17.08.2022 passed by XVII Additional Member Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Indore (M.P.) in Claim Case No.2600/2018, whereby appellant/injured has been awarded an amount of Rs.6,93,580/-.
2.

entities.text: XVII Additional Member Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The appeal is on the point that permanent disability despite the evidence available on record has been taken as only 8% which should have been at least 15%.
On other heads also, enhancement is required.
Without specifying the heads, learned counsel submits that if Rs.1,50,000/- is enhanced over and above the amount awarded by the Claims Tribunal, it will be just and proper compensation.
Hence, prays for additional lump sum amount of Rs.1,50,000/- by allowing the appeal.

3 . Per contra, learned counsel for the Insurance Company has NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2026:MPHC-IND:8905 2 MA-3525-2023 opposed the prayer.
4. Heard and considered the submissions of the learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
5. From perusal of the record, as per disability certificate Ex.P-88, appellant has suffered permanent disability of 23% and 28% in left leg and right hand.
It has been proved by Dr.Kush Bandi (AW-2).
Even if the aforesaid disability is considered in proportion of the whole body, at least it should have been 15%.

Without going into the nicety of the calculation and looking to the disability suffered by the appellant/injured, this Court is of the view that if a lump sum amount of Rs.1,50,000/- is enhanced that will be just and proper compensation.

Accordingly, this Misc. Appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation by Rs.1,50,000/-
over and above the amount, which has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The amount will also carry interest at the same rate as awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The other terms and conditions of the impugned award shall remain intact.
